children: Overview
China online media and gaming group's Q3 revenue fell 26% yr/yr
Company posted non-GAAP net loss of $15 mln, reversing profit from prior year
Online game revenues dropped 30% yr/yr, mainly due to high base after prior-year launches
Outlook
Sohu sees Q4 marketing services revenue between $13 mln and $14 mln
Company expects Q4 online game revenue between $111 mln and $121 mln
Sohu forecasts Q4 net loss between $17 mln and $27 mln
Result Drivers
HIGH BASE EFFECT - Co said online game revenue declined due to a high comparison base from prior-year content updates and game launches
OLDER GAME DECLINE - Co attributed lower active user and payer numbers to the natural decline of older games
CONTENT UPDATES - Co said it introduced new content and tailored gameplay to maintain player engagement
